notes.title: Announcing SHAPELAND now available!
notes.content:
[p]This wacky game is not like any other![/p][p]
It's a celebration of physics and fun disguised as a 3D arcade adventure exploration 
replayable singleplayer extravaganza.

8/20/2025 fixed the Community Leaderboard problem.[/p]

notes.title: New Demo!
notes.content:
We've got a new DEMO ready for you!
Lots of improvements based on user feedback.

Incuding:

Now there's an OPTIONS MENU-

Now there's an AUDIO MENU-

Now you can toggle LUMEN off/on-

Improved object collision-

Colored smoke (this was really necessary)-

An additional enemy that attacks player-

Demo has its own page-
        Now you can leave Steam reviews!

NOW YOU CAN LEAVE STEAM REVIEWS!
